recipes.name: Feijoada
recipes.description: A hearty pot of Brazilian-style black beans with pork.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Soak the black beans if needed, then drain them before cooking so the stew starts with clean, evenly hydrated beans.
Dice the pork and onion, keeping the pieces similar in size so they cook evenly.
Mince the garlic finely so the flavor spreads evenly through the dish.
Brown the pork in vegetable oil, stirring or turning as needed until the surface develops good color.
Add the beans, onion, garlic, bay leaf, and water, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Simmer gently until the beans are tender and season with salt, stirring occasionally and watching for the texture described.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Moqueca de Peixe
recipes.description: A Brazilian fish stew with tomato and coconut milk.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Cut the white fish into large pieces, keeping the pieces large enough to stay intact while cooking.
Slice the onion, tomato, and bell pepper evenly so it softens at the same pace.
Cook the vegetables in vegetable oil until soft, stirring occasionally until they soften and release some moisture.
Add the coconut milk and simmer briefly until the mixture reaches the right texture.
Add the fish and cook until tender, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Pão de Queijo
recipes.description: Small Brazilian cheese breads with a chewy center.
instructions: Preheat the oven before assembling the recipe so it is ready when the dish needs to bake.
Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Heat the whole milk and vegetable oil in a saucepan.
Pour the hot liquid over the tapioca starch and mix.
Add the eggs and cheese gradually, mixing until the dough becomes cohesive and slightly sticky.
Shape the dough into small balls, spacing them apart so heat can circulate around each one.
Bake until puffed and lightly golden, checking near the end so it does not overcook.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Brazilian Carrot Cake
recipes.description: A soft carrot cake with a simple chocolate topping.
instructions: Preheat the oven before assembling the recipe so it is ready when the dish needs to bake.
Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Peel, trim, and cut the carrot into pieces into even pieces.
Blend the carrot with eggs, sugar, and vegetable oil until completely smooth.
Fold in the plain flour and baking powder gently so the mixture stays light and evenly combined.
Bake the batter until the cake is firm, checking near the end so it does not overcook.
Cook cocoa powder, whole milk, butter, and sugar into a topping and pour over the cake.
Let the dessert cool, set, or rest as needed before serving so the final texture holds properly.

recipes.name: Chicken Tinga
recipes.description: Mexican shredded chicken simmered in tomato and chili sauce.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Boil the chicken breast until cooked through.
Shred the chicken with two forks finely, keeping the pieces loose so they cook down evenly.
Blend the tomato, garlic, and chipotle pepper until completely smooth.
Cook the onion in vegetable oil and add the sauce, stirring often so it softens without burning.
Add the chicken and simmer until thick until the mixture reaches the right texture.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Beef Picadillo
recipes.description: A Mexican beef dish cooked with potato, tomato, and spices.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Dice the potato and onion, keeping the pieces similar in size so they cook evenly.
Mince the garlic finely so the flavor spreads evenly through the dish.
Brown the beef in vegetable oil, stirring or turning as needed until the surface develops good color.
Add the potato, onion, garlic, tomato, and cumin, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Simmer gently until the potato is tender, stirring occasionally and watching for the texture described.
Season with salt and serve warm.
Check the final texture before serving so the dish feels balanced and ready.

recipes.name: Mexican Street Corn Salad
recipes.description: A creamy corn salad inspired by Mexican street corn.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Cook the corn in a pan until lightly browned.
Chop the cilantro finely so it mixes evenly into the final dish.
Mix mayonnaise, lime juice, chili powder, and salt.
Fold the corn and cheese into the dressing.
Serve warm or chilled, depending on the texture you prefer.
Taste the final mixture and adjust only with the seasonings already listed if needed before serving.

recipes.name: Guacamole
recipes.description: A simple avocado dip with lime, onion, and cilantro.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Cut the avocados, remove the pits, and scoop the flesh into a bowl while keeping any firm pieces small enough to mash.
Dice the onion and tomato, keeping the pieces similar in size so they cook evenly.
Chop the cilantro finely so it mixes evenly into the final dish.
Mash the avocado with lime juice and salt until smooth, then adjust the texture by stirring a little more if needed.
Fold in the onion, tomato, and cilantro gently so the mixture stays light and evenly combined.
Taste the final mixture and adjust only with the seasonings already listed if needed before serving.

recipes.name: Mexican Rice
recipes.description: A tomato-flavored rice side dish cooked in one pot.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Dice the onion and mince the garlic, keeping the pieces similar in size so they cook evenly.
Toast the rice in vegetable oil, stirring until the grains look lightly glossy.
Add the onion and garlic, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Pour in the tomato sauce and vegetable broth.
Simmer gently until the rice is tender, stirring occasionally and watching for the texture described.
Let the finished dish settle briefly if needed, then serve it while the texture and temperature are at their best.

recipes.name: Brigadeiro Pots
recipes.description: Creamy Brazilian chocolate sweets served in small cups.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Add the sweetened condensed milk, cocoa powder, and butter to a saucepan, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Cook over low heat while stirring constantly.
Stop cooking when the mixture becomes thick and creamy and pulls slightly from the bottom of the pan.
Pour the mixture into small cups, then smooth the surface before adding the topping or chilling.
Top evenly with chocolate sprinkles before serving so the surface browns consistently.
Let the dessert cool, set, or rest as needed before serving so the final texture holds properly.
